justification: Inspected `byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/dynamic/DynamicType.java` at lines 3674-3717 and 1182-1269, plus the implementation flow at 4327-4405. `Initial` is a narrow fluent builder step with only four overloads of `withParameters(...)`; its abstract base only adapts those overloads and delegates onward. The surrounding builder API uses it only as the first stage for method/constructor definition before exceptions and type variables are added, so it does not show the multi-responsibility or broad method set expected for insufficient modularization.
